itens.titulo: 1 Obvious Metric That Makes Nvidia a Top Stock to Buy Now
itens.descricao: 1 Obvious Metric That Makes Nvidia a Top Stock to Buy Now Yahoo Finance
trechos: In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
Continue » The market isn't baking in any of 2027's growth The metric I'm focusing on here is next year's forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio.
Though it's based on estimates, this metric is actually fairly solid, as Nvidia has already told investors that it expects 70% revenue growth next year.
If Nvidia hits Wall Street estimates for next year, and its stock doesn't move in price from now until then, it will trade for less than 14 times earnings.
NVDA PE Ratio (Forward 1y) data by YCharts.
Currently, its trailing P/E ratio is 28, which is quite reasonable for a company of Nvidia's caliber.
If Nvidia meets its earnings growth expectations and also trades at 28 times earnings at the end of its next fiscal year (ending January 2028), the stock would double between now and then.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin's $350,000 price target comes with a terrifying warning, analyst says
itens.descricao: Bitcoin's $350,000 price target comes with a terrifying warning, analyst says Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: On Thursday in a post on X, he said a 70% to 80% drop is likely in a few years.
Given the heavy support between $100,000 and $125,000, though, he said a run to $350,000 or higher would be needed to unlock it.

"Since BTC will likely get a real Bear market in a few years where it drops 70%-80%, given the amount of support between 100k-125k going to $350k+ will be required to unlock a 70%+ Bear market for Bitcoin," he wrote in the post.
Bitcoin trades near about $82,000 today at the time of writing.
He pointed to 2028 as the likely top.
The analyst said he used weekly cycles to call the bottom on July 1 "to the day," while others expected an October low.
He also expects Bitcoin to exceed $250,000 after its climb from about $69,000 to $125,000.
Bitcoin dominance is elevated while altcoin dominance sits near a floor, he noted, a setup he says matches 2016 and 2020.

itens.titulo: Dólar cai 0,28% e Bolsa registra alta de 0,54%
itens.descricao: Dólar cai 0,28% e Bolsa registra alta de 0,54% Poder360
trechos: Dólar cai 0,28% e Bolsa registra alta de 0,54% Moeda norte-americana fechou cotada em R$ 5,073; Ibovespa, principal índice da B3, chegou aos 205.430,33 pontos O dólar comercial caiu 0,28% e fechou cotado a R$ 5,073 nesta 6ª feira (16.out.2026).
O Ibovespa, principal índice da B3 (Bolsa de Valores de São Paulo), subiu 0,54%, aos 205.430,33 pontos.
A Bolsa interrompeu uma sequência de 3 pregões consecutivos de queda, mas acumulou desvalorização de 1,7% na semana.
A recuperação do Ibovespa foi insuficiente para compensar as perdas acumuladas desde a 3ª feira (13.out).
O índice havia encerrado a 5ª feira (15.out) aos 204.324,26 pontos, com recuo de 1,06%.
O IBC-Br (Índice de Atividade Econômica do Banco Central), considerado uma prévia do PIB (Produto Interno Bruto), avançou 0,3% em agosto.
Apesar do resultado positivo no mês, o indicador acumulou retração de 0,6% no trimestre encerrado em agosto.
O desempenho reforça os sinais de desaceleração da economia no 2º semestre e influencia as expectativas dos investidores sobre os próximos passos da política monetária.

itens.titulo: Prediction: $1,000 Invested in Taiwan Semi (TSMC) Today Will Be Worth This Much by 2030.
itens.descricao: Prediction: $1,000 Invested in Taiwan Semi (TSMC) Today Will Be Worth This Much by 2030. Yahoo Finance
trechos: Over the past four years, a $1,000 investment in TSMC (NYSE: TSM), the world's largest contract chipmaker, would have grown to about $4,540.
Could a fresh $1,000 investment in TSMC grow to more than $4,500 again by the end of the decade?
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.

TSMC's scale enables it to push ASML's current-gen "low-NA" EUV systems to their theoretical limits (to 1.4nm) before it needs to buy ASML's pricier "high-NA" EUV systems to produce even smaller chips.
By waiting until the early 2030s to ramp up its purchases of high-NA EUV systems, TSMC can wait for the technology to mature and become cheaper before making that leap.

In the third quarter of 2026, TSMC generated 68% of its revenue from the high-performance computing (HPC) market -- which includes Nvidia's data center GPUs and Broadcom's custom application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) for hyperscalers.
That segment's revenue surged 22% sequentially in the third quarter, accelerating from 20% sequential growth in the first and second quarters.

itens.titulo: Cantor's $112,000 Bitcoin Call Lifts Strategy Target to $208
itens.descricao: Cantor's $112,000 Bitcoin Call Lifts Strategy Target to $208 Yahoo Finance
trechos: Cantor Fitzgerald raised its price target on Strategy (NASDAQ:MSTR) from $186 to $208 and kept an Overweight rating.
The firm lifted its 12-month forward bitcoin price assumption to $112,000 from $98,000, taking a more bullish view on the asset after recent market strength.
Strategy shares were down 3.32% in premarket.
GuruFocus has detected 9 Warning Signs with MSTR.
The firm applies 2x enterprise value to sales on Strategy's estimated 2027 sales of $509 million and values Strategy's 848,000 bitcoin at the new price assumption.
That lifts its enterprise value estimate to $110 billion from $97 billion.
At $112,000 each, those holdings would be worth about $95 billion.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa sobe puxado por Petrobras e com atenção a pesquisas, mas cai 1,74% na semana
itens.descricao: Ibovespa sobe puxado por Petrobras e com atenção a pesquisas, mas cai 1,74% na semana InfoMoney
trechos: Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa subiu 0,54%, a 205.430,33 pontos, após marcar 204.164,17 na mínima e 206.305,26 na máxima do dia.
Na semana, o Ibovespa acumulou 1,74% de baixa.
O volume financeiro no pregão desta sexta-feira somou R$ 43,39 bilhões antes dos ajustes finais.
Uma pesquisa do instituto MDA contratada pela Confederação Nacional do Transporte (CNT) divulgada nesta manhã mostrou Flávio com 46,8% das intenções de voto enquanto Lula soma 45,9%.
A margem de erro de 2,2 pontos percentuais coloca os dois candidatos em empate técnico.

Os números confirmaram a tendência observada na pesquisa Datafolha publicada na noite de quinta-feira, que mostrou Flávio com 47% das intenções de voto e Lula com 45%, também indicando um empate técnico.

“A nove dias da votação, a volatilidade deve continuar elevada, e o fluxo deve seguir condicionado a novas pesquisas”, disse Maria Carolina Luchesi, especialista de investimentos do Grupo Hike Capital.
Já o Inter elevou a sua projeção do Ibovespa para 2027, de 204 mil para 240 mil pontos.

itens.descricao: AML Penalty Could Be A Game Changer For Bank of America Stock (BAC) Yahoo Finance
trechos: - Bank of America reported third quarter 2026 results that missed expectations, as a regulatory penalty of more than US$1.21b related to anti money laundering and sanctions compliance weighed on net income of US$6,933m and diluted EPS of US$0.91.

Scan how compliance risk is being priced across the sector by reviewing our curated 32 resilient stocks with low risk scores while you assess what this penalty means for Bank of America's long term profile.
The immediate swing factor is execution on expense control while continuing to fund AI and compliance upgrades after the US$1.21b penalty.
The biggest current risk is that regulatory and technology spending pushes the roughly US$18.6b quarterly expense run rate higher just as investment banking and trading fees face pressure.
Net income of US$6,933m and diluted EPS of US$0.91 reflected the anti money laundering settlement, yet net interest income of US$16,449m showed the basic banking engine at work.
Against that backdrop, the new US$90m 6.00% notes due 2032 are worth watching.
Bank of America's narrative projects US$137.8b revenue and US$38.2b earnings by 2029.
This is based on an assumption of 6.6% yearly revenue growth and about a US$6.1b increase in earnings from US$32.1b today.
